title: How Springdale got its name #Shorts
description:
Springdale began in 1862 as a cotton mission farm town at the mouth of Zion Canyon. Local lore explains the name.

Photos: inkknife_2000, Don Graham and Ivy I. Anderson (CC BY-SA, Wikimedia Commons); George A. Grant / National Park Service, Donald W. Dickensheets and Brian C. Grogan / HABS-HAER (public domain).
